# Copilot Instructions for Passgrinder Desktop

- Project: Flutter desktop menu-bar app that mirrors the Passgrinder Chrome extension look/behavior; single screen password generator.
- State: `GeneratorService` (Provider `ChangeNotifier`) holds `masterPassword`, `uniquePhrase`, `variation`, `generatedPassword`, `showPassword`; setters auto-call `_generatePassword()` then `notifyListeners()`.
- Password algorithm: see [lib/models/password_generator.dart](lib/models/password_generator.dart); MD5(master) + MD5(unique) + MD5(variation) bytes concatenated, MD5 hashed again, encoded via custom Z85 alphabet to always return a 20-char password. Keep logic identical to extension (no length/charset options).
- UI flow: [lib/screens/home_screen.dart](lib/screens/home_screen.dart) has two `TextField`s (master, unique phrase), radio buttons for 4 variations (0=Default), and shows `PasswordField` when password exists; copy uses `Clipboard.setData` and shows green floating `SnackBar`. Reset clears controllers + service.
- Password display: [lib/widgets/password_field.dart](lib/widgets/password_field.dart) masks with `*`, uses SourceCodePro mono, provides copy + show/hide icons from FontAwesome.
- Theming: set in [lib/main.dart](lib/main.dart) to match extension palette (bg #1e2629, primary green #6baf78). Fonts loaded via assets (Lato for body, SourceCodePro for mono) from `pubspec.yaml`.
- macOS shell: native status item in [macos/Runner/AppDelegate.swift](macos/Runner/AppDelegate.swift). Left-click toggles window visibility; right-click temporarily sets `statusItem.menu` to show Quit. Menu cleared in `menuDidClose` to restore left-click. Window positioned under status icon via `positionWindowNearStatusBar()`; avoid regressing icon sizing (16px square from `assets/icon/app_icon.png`).
- Window chrome: [macos/Runner/MainFlutterWindow.swift](macos/Runner/MainFlutterWindow.swift) creates borderless, transparent, floating window fixed to 460x360; hides system buttons; hides on click outside via delayed `resignKey`. Keep size/behavior unless intentionally changing UX.
- Platform builds: per [BUILD.md](BUILD.md). Use `flutter run -d macos` for local dev. `build_all.sh` cleans, `flutter pub get`, builds for current OS only (macOS builds universal, packages DMG; Linux tarball; Windows zip). Cross-platform artifacts normally come from GitHub Actions (`.github/workflows/build.yml`).
- Assets: icon at assets/icon/app_icon.png (also used for status bar), fonts under assets/fonts/. `flutter_launcher_icons` config in `pubspec.yaml` generates per-platform icons.
- Dependencies: provider for state, crypto for MD5, font_awesome_flutter for icons, package_info_plus for version display, no window_manager plugin (native AppKit instead). Avoid introducing plugins that conflict with custom macOS window/status handling.
- Testing: only default widget test present; add targeted tests near `PasswordGenerator` if adjusting algorithm.
- Coding patterns: prefer updating `GeneratorService` setters to trigger regeneration + notify; UI listens via `Consumer`. Maintain dark theme styles and padding constants used in `HomeScreen` to keep extension parity.
- File locations: main entry [lib/main.dart](lib/main.dart); service [lib/services/generator_service.dart](lib/services/generator_service.dart); model [lib/models/password_generator.dart](lib/models/password_generator.dart); primary UI [lib/screens/home_screen.dart](lib/screens/home_screen.dart); password display [lib/widgets/password_field.dart](lib/widgets/password_field.dart).
- Releases: Tags `v*` create versioned release assets; manual runs via the Actions “workflow_dispatch” also publish releases. Pushes to `main` do not auto-publish.
